q.en: "The reasons for his absence ___ unclear." Which verb fits?
q.bn: "The reasons for his absence ___ unclear." কোন verb বসবে?

why.en: The real subject is "reasons" (plural), not "absence" — words in between don't change agreement.
why.bn: আসল subject হলো "reasons" (plural), "absence" না — মাঝের শব্দগুলো agreement বদলায় না।

q.en: "Everyone ___ finished the test." Which verb fits?
q.bn: "Everyone ___ finished the test." কোন verb বসবে?

why.en: "Everyone" (like everybody, nobody, someone) is always grammatically singular.
why.bn: "Everyone" (everybody, nobody, someone-এর মতো) সবসময় grammatically singular।

q.en: "Neither the manager nor the staff ___ aware of the change." Which verb fits?
q.bn: "Neither the manager nor the staff ___ aware of the change." কোন verb বসবে?

why.en: With "neither...nor," the verb agrees with the nearer subject — "the staff" (plural).
why.bn: "neither...nor"-এ verb agree করে কাছের subject-এর সাথে — "the staff" (plural)।

q.en: "The number of candidates ___ risen sharply this year." Which verb fits?
q.bn: "The number of candidates ___ risen sharply this year." কোন verb বসবে?

why.en: "The number of" is itself the singular subject here — different from "a number of," which takes a plural verb.
why.bn: "The number of" নিজেই এখানে singular subject — "a number of"-এর থেকে আলাদা, যেটা plural verb নেয়।

q.en: "A number of students ___ already applied." Which verb fits?
q.bn: "A number of students ___ already applied." কোন verb বসবে?

why.en: "A number of" + a plural noun takes a plural verb.
why.bn: "A number of" + plural noun-এ plural verb বসে।
